parttimedigitalmarketingcommunicationsco.title: Part-Time Digital Marketing & Communications Coordinator
parttimedigitalmarketingcommunicationsco.description:
Part-Time Digital Marketing & Communications Coordinator
  

   United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona (UCPSA) Tucson, Arizona
 
 
  Part-Time | 20–25 Hours Per Week | Flexible Schedule l Pay Commensurate With Experience 
  

 
 
  

  
Help Us Grow a Brand That Reflects Our Mission
  

  

   United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona (UCPSA) is seeking a creative, resourceful, and digitally savvy Part-Time Digital Marketing & Communications Coordinator to help strengthen our brand, expand our digital presence, and share the stories of the people and communities we serve. UCPSA provides home and community-based services for children and adults with disabilities and older adults throughout Southern Arizona. Our mission is meaningful, our culture is collaborative, and our work changes lives every day. 
  

  

   We are looking for someone who can translate that impact into compelling digital content. This role is ideal for a communications or marketing professional who enjoys variety, works well independently, brings fresh ideas to the table, and is looking for meaningful work with a flexible part-time schedule. 
  

  
What You'll Do
  

   In this role, you'll help shape how UCPSA shows up online and in the community. 
  

   Responsibilities include: 
  

  
   Help develop and strengthen UCPSA's digital brand and online presence
   Manage and update website content to ensure information is current, engaging, and easy to navigate
   Create, schedule, and manage content across UCPSA's social media platforms
   Develop email newsletters, internal communications, announcements, and promotional materials
   Write and edit stories that highlight UCPSA's employees, programs, families, community partnerships, events, and impact
   Support digital marketing campaigns designed to increase awareness, engagement, recruitment, and community visibility
   Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across communication channels
   Create or coordinate photography and visual content for digital and print use
   Assist with event promotion and community outreach communications
   Review website, email, and social media performance data and identify opportunities to improve engagement
   Collaborate with leadership and staff to identify stories, communication needs, and marketing opportunities
   Stay current on emerging digital marketing practices, communication trends, and technology
  
  
What You Bring
  

   Minimum Qualifications 
  

  
   High school diploma or equivalent
   At least two years of professional experience in marketing, communications, public relations, digital media, advertising, social media, or a closely related field
   Experience creating content for social media, websites, newsletters, or other digital platforms
   Experience working within a website content management system
   Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and verbal communication skills
   Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and the ability to quickly learn new technology and software
   Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
   Ability to work independently, use sound judgment, and follow projects through to completion
   A combination of relevant education, training, and professional experience may be considered when it demonstrates the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position
   Valid Arizona Driver's License and an acceptable driving record when driving is required for position responsibilities
   Ability to obtain a Level 1 Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card and pass comprehensive background checks (ex. Adult Protective Services, Department of Child Safety etc.)
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  

   We'd be especially interested in candidates who bring one or more of the following: 
  

  
   Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, Graphic Design, or a related discipline
   Experience working for a nonprofit, human services, healthcare, disability services, or other mission-focused organization
   Photography and/or video production experience
   Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar graphic design tools
   Experience creating and managing email marketing campaigns and newsletters
   Familiarity with Google Analytics, social media insights, or other digital performance tools
   Understanding of SEO, content strategy, digital branding, and audience engagement
   Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns across several communication channels
   Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish
  
  
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  

   The person who will thrive in this position will be able to: 
  

  
   Create clear, engaging, and audience-appropriate content across multiple digital platforms
   Understand how social media, website content, email marketing, storytelling, and visual design work together to support a brand
   Maintain website content using common content management systems
   Develop content that supports organizational goals while remaining authentic and mission-focused
   Turn ideas, programs, and everyday moments into compelling stories
   Write professionally with strong attention to grammar, tone, accuracy, and consistency
   Use analytics and audience feedback to improve digital content and communication strategies
   Manage projects independently without requiring extensive day-to-day direction
   Take initiative, identify opportunities, and bring forward new ideas
   Learn new platforms, tools, and digital practices as technology evolves
   Collaborate effectively with employees, leadership, community partners, and outside vendors
   Communicate respectfully and effectively with people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences
  
  
Physical Requirements
  

   This position is generally classified as light work. 
  

  

   Employees may occasionally need to move or carry items weighing up to approximately 20 pounds and frequently handle lighter materials or equipment.
 
 
 
  The role also involves regular computer use and may include periods of sitting, standing, walking, taking photographs, attending meetings, and participating in UCPSA or community events. 
  

  
Why Join UCPSA?
  

   At UCPSA, your work will help tell the stories of people with disabilities, older adults, families, employees, and programs that make a real difference in Southern Arizona.
 
 
  
We offer:
  

  
   20–25 hours per week
   A flexible work schedule
  
 
 
  Eligible for PTO and dental insurance
  A supportive and collaborative workplace
  Meaningful work connected to an important mission
  The opportunity to help shape and grow UCPSA's digital brand
  Room to bring your ideas, creativity, and personality to the role
 
 
  
Ready to Tell Stories That Matter?
  

   Please submit your résumé along with examples of your work. Samples may include social media content, newsletters, writing, website content, marketing campaigns, photography, graphic design, or other communications projects. 
  

  

   If you're creative, curious, dependable, and excited about using digital marketing to help a mission-driven organization grow, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 

 
  

  

   At United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona, we value a diverse, inclusive workforce and we provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to an individuals race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. If you are unable to submit your application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at rmurray@ucpsa.org 
  

  

   United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities to the extent required by applicable law.

marketingmanageraifirstremotepuffy.title: Marketing Manager , AI-First (Remote)
marketingmanageraifirstremotepuffy.description:
Turn consumer insights into campaigns and partnerships that grow a $1Billion+ e-commerce brand.




Total Annual Package: Up to USD $143,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

Location: Remote (USA)

Growth path from here is Senior Marketing Manager → Head of Creative Strategy. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.




We've been AI-first since December 2023: AI supports how we research consumers, explore campaign ideas, and develop creative briefs and scripts. You'll use it throughout your work, applying your own judgment to challenge outputs, refine recommendations, and guide the final creative direction.




Role Overview:

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring a Marketing Manager, AI-First, to own the path from consumer insight to campaign, covering consumer research, campaign strategy, AI-assisted creative briefs and scripts, and selected strategic partnerships, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing.




This role exists to turn what online shoppers actually need into campaigns and creative that perform, building the research-to-brief process that lets our creative and paid channel teams produce effective assets without starting from a blank page.




This is an individual contributor role open only to candidates currently located in the United States.




The Problems You'll Own:




Primary: Turn research into relevant campaigns: Identify what matters to online shoppers and translate those insights into clear messaging and creative ideas. Develop briefs and scripts that connect customer needs with product benefits and help teams produce effective assets. Bring feedback from paid channels into the next round of concepts and improvements.Secondary: Manage selected exclusive strategic affiliate partnerships for high-impact projects, including coordinating partner activities and reviewing performance with marketing leadership.


The Career Accelerator:

This is not a role where you fill in someone else's brief or report on campaigns after they've run.




The scope is scarce: very few Marketing Managers get simultaneous ownership over consumer research, the briefs and scripts behind an AI video generation team, and strategic partnerships for growth, including relevant affiliate relationships, and a direct line to the Director of Marketing with no layers in between.Your first 12 months: build a research base on customers, competitors, buying patterns, and market trends. Turn it into campaign ideas, messaging angles, and creative strategies grounded in purchase motivations. Write the briefs, concepts, and ad scripts that give our AI video generation, design, and content teams clear direction. Bring finished assets to market with the paid channel teams, and feed performance results into the next round of concepts. Coordinate selected strategic partnerships, including relevant affiliate relationships, and review their performance with marketing leadership. Shape the future of creative strategy at Puffy, where consumer insight sets the direction for performance creative.


What Is In It For You:

This isn't just another marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.




1. Direct the Creative Before It's Made

You find the insight, write the brief, see it through to performance, and help grow selected strategic partnerships.Your research sets the campaign ideas, messaging angles, and creative strategies. Your briefs and ad scripts go directly to our AI video generation, design, and content teams and shape what they produce.You work with the paid channel teams to bring finished assets to market, then use performance feedback to decide what comes next. You report directly to the Director of Marketing and work together on marketing priorities, campaign ideas, and strategic partnerships.You manage selected exclusive strategic affiliate partnerships. You coordinate partner activities and work with marketing leadership to review opportunities, progress, and performance.


2. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales🌍 Great Place to Work Certified💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand




3. Embrace Radical Flexibility

Work from anywhere in the US. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office or a co-working space. Your output is your credential, not your location.




4. Become the Marketer Who Knows Why Customers Buy

In most companies, campaign marketers take a brief from someone else and fill in the copy. Here, you're the person who decides which customer need a campaign speaks to and why. When a concept moves into production, your research and brief are the reason the creative team builds it that way. You'll build the instinct to find what actually drives an online purchase — and the scriptwriting craft to turn it into direction a creative team can execute. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a blank page in front of you.




What You'll Need:

5+ years of marketing experience, including at least 2 years with D2C e-commerce brands. Experience limited to offline businesses or retail-store marketing does not meet this requirement.Ability to develop performance marketing campaign ideas and creative strategies informed by consumer insights.Understanding of how digital advertising platforms, including Meta, Google Search, and Demand Gen, work.Ability to research consumer preferences, buying patterns, and market trends, and translate findings into relevant messaging.Understanding of ad copywriting, scriptwriting, and creative concept development, with the ability to communicate clear direction to creative teams.Practical ability to use AI tools for research, ideation, creative briefs, and script development.Ability to work independently, own assigned projects, and collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners.


Good-to-Have:

Experience with an online mattress brand. Candidates from other relevant D2C e-commerce brands will also be considered.Experience supporting strategic growth partnerships, including affiliate or publisher relationships. Specialist affiliate expertise is not required.


The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.


✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits:




💰 Compensation:

Total Annual Package: Up to USD $143,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base).Annual salary review every January


🏥 Health & Protection:

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance


🌴 Time Off:

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + US public holidays


💼 Work Environment:

AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stackRemote First: Work from the comfort of your home officeUp to $5,000 annual learning budget for courses and certificationsInternational team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.


🏆 Rewards & Recognition:

Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreatsEligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions


✅ Other Benefits: 

401(k) with Company Match

Free Puffy mattress

$1,000 Puffy/Halo Board store credit after 1 year Puffy product discount up to 50%




Ready to Shape Your Story? 

Click "Apply" and take the first step.

fieldmarketingspecialisttucsonazfernway.description:
Description
 
  

   We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Field Marketing Specialist to support our Field Marketing Manager in executing strategic marketing initiatives in and around Tucson AZ. The Field Marketing Specialist will be responsible for ensuring top-tier in-store execution, fostering relationships with retailers and consumers, and providing critical marketing support to our retail partners. This role will be pivotal in driving brand awareness, sales growth, and maintaining strong retail relationships.
 
 

    Key Responsibilities
 

 
  Support In-Store Execution: Ensure 100% execution of in-store marketing strategies, including displays, merchandising, and promotional setups, to maintain consistent brand visibility across all retail partners.
  Manage In-Store Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with store staff, acting as the primary point of contact to ensure seamless collaboration, provide support, and address any concerns.
  Budtender Training: Conduct regular training sessions with budtenders to educate them on Fernway products, promotions, and selling points to drive better customer engagement and product knowledge.
  Retail Store Incentives: Manage and track incentive programs to engage and motivate budtenders and store teams to promote and sell Fernway products.
  Merchandising and Display: Oversee the setup, refresh, and maintenance of product displays to ensure they are always up to brand standards.
  Promotional Support: Assist with the execution of in-store promotions and product launches, ensuring that all retail marketing efforts are aligned with brand objectives.
  Swag and Promotional Materials Management: Handle the inventory, distribution, and management of swag and promotional materials, ensuring that all stores are adequately stocked for upcoming events and promotions.
  Event Coordination: Assist in planning and executing events, activations, and pop-ups, including managing logistics, setup, and breakdown, ensuring smooth and successful operations.
  Collaboration with Sales and Retail Partners: Work closely with the commercial sales team and retail partners to align field marketing efforts with sales objectives, driving growth at the store level.
  Compliance with Cannabis Regulations: Ensure that all marketing activities adhere to state and local cannabis regulations and guidelines.
  Target Work Schedule: Tuesday to Saturday’s (Sunday + Monday off) 
   
    Tuesday & Wednesday: Flex (office/field) days to schedule pop ups, organize marketing material, meet with retail marketing partners, account maintenance
    Thursday, Friday & Saturday: Field days focused on visual merchandising, pop-ups, events & trainings
   

 
 

 Skills, Knowledge and Requirements
 

 
  2+ years of experience in brand marketing, event planning, or a similar role
  Strong time-management and organizational skills
  Highly approachable and team-oriented personality
  Strong attention to detail and a passion for execution
  Proficiency in Hubspot and/or other CRM platforms
  Social media proficiency (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn)
  Experience with Canva or Adobe Creative Suite is a plus
  Ability to travel to retail locations and events as needed throughout the Tucson area
  Comfortable with technology and various marketing tools
 
 
  

   Must have one of the following:
 
 
  AZ driver's license
  AZ identification card
  Valid FA Card
  U.S. passport
 
 
  

 
 

 Experience the Fernway Advantage
 

 
  Generous annual leave: 13 paid holidays and up to 3 weeks PTO (hourly and salaried staff alike)
  Comprehensive health coverage: company-sponsored health, dental, and vision insurance
  Extra benefits: PSL, FSA, HSA, disability, paid parental leave, volunteer days, life insurance, 401(k) with match, discounted pet insurance, company discount program, and gym membership reimbursements, paid lunches
 
 
 

    About Fernway
 
  Fernway is an industry-leading cannabis brand that is actively expanding into innovative product categories and new state markets. Our unwavering commitment to premium quality cannabis products, exceptional customer service and strategic partnerships are what set us apart. 
  

 
 
  We pride ourselves on nurturing an employee-first culture that has helped catapult us to the top of the industry. We are accepting, inclusive and diverse. We embody cannabis culture from top to bottom and act as one team. That is what has made us successful. 
  

  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  

   Fernway provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Fernway is dedicated to building a diverse team.
 

Pay: $50,000.00 - $52,000.00 per year

strategicpartnershipsmanagerdigitalmarke.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
strategicpartnershipsmanagerdigitalmarke.description:
As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.

 

ERP analysts in the mid-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.

 

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.

 

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.

 

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments.


Responsibilities

ERP analyst relationships

Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid-market ERP buyers and channel partners.Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid-market platform to their audiences and clients.Track analyst-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting. 

Digital marketing agency relationships

Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product-market fit.Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co-marketing and lead-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.Track agency-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment. 

Portfolio management & reporting

Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go-to-market teams. 

Cross-functional collaboration

Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.Work with marketing to develop analyst-specific content programs, agency co-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid-market ERP ecosystem.Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst-generated content and recommendations.
Qualifications

Required

10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.Familiarity with the mid-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.Strong communication and relationship-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pipeline tracking and attribution discipline.Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales and partnership productivity platforms. 

Preferred

Direct experience working with mid-market ERP channel analysts, software selection consultants, or VAR-channel commentators — you have existing relationships in this community.Experience building agency partner programs, including referral process design, lead qualification frameworks, and co-marketing infrastructure.Familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Advanced, or competing mid-market ERP platforms (Sage Intacct, Acumatica, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. 

 The expected base pay range for this position is: 
 Albany $189,500 - $256,000 
 California Remote (Bay Area) $186,500- $252,500

Unió Digital has grown almost entirely on word of mouth. This role is how we widen that. The Marketing & Business Development Coordinator owns top-of-funnel engagement: the vendor-funded programs, the hosted events, the social presence, and the content that puts us in front of Arizona businesses before they have a problem to solve.

headofmarketingsymmetrygusto.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About The Role

Symmetry Software is seeking a dynamic and experienced Head of Marketing to lead our enterprise B2B marketing efforts. As a key member of the leadership team, you will create, shape, and execute our marketing strategy. You will empower a full stack enterprise marketing team, including demand generation, product marketing, digital marketing and online presence, sales enablement, analytics and reporting, and lifecycle marketing, all with AI at the core.

Symmetry is an AI native company, and our ideal candidate builds AI natively into how the marketing function operates. We're looking for a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of technical products, including MCPs, APIs, and SDKs, who has a proven track record driving successful marketing initiatives in the enterprise space. You will operate in both a leadership and builder capacity. This role reports to the Head of Symmetry.

About The Team

Symmetry Software is the payroll infrastructure for software and payroll platforms, powering the paychecks of over 64 million workers each year. Our fully integrated suite of payroll tax APIs and software tools helps companies solve tax compliance issues and build applications across the entire payroll process. Our AI products are increasingly reshaping what's possible for tax compliance infrastructure when it comes to accuracy and speed. Symmetry is the heart of the payroll industry, providing best in class software support built on nearly four decades of experience with the most complicated tax and payroll scenarios across the country.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Develop Comprehensive Marketing Strategies: Craft and execute marketing plans aligned with Symmetry’s objectives, ensuring consistent brand messaging and market positioning.Drive Demand Generation and Lead Nurturing: Oversee multi-channel demand generation initiatives, attracting B2B enterprise clients and guiding them through effective lead nurturing programs.Build and Mentor a High-Performing Team: Lead a skilled marketing team, fostering innovation and collaboration in demand generation, product & lifecycle marketing, digital strategies, and sales enablement.Enhance Digital Presence and Visibility: Strengthen Symmetry’s digital presence through strategic online campaigns, SEO optimization, and compelling content, maximizing brand visibility and attracting qualified leads.Enable Sales Teams for Success: Provide sales teams with impactful collateral, training, and tools to effectively communicate technical product value, ensuring achievement of bookings targets.Implement Data-Driven Lifecycle Marketing: Develop customer lifecycle marketing programs, enhancing retention and loyalty, while identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities to drive revenue growth.Amplify the Symmetry brand: Own and enhance the positioning and messaging of Symmetry’s brand.Leverage Data for Informed Decisions: Utilize analytics and reporting tools to collect, analyze, and interpret marketing data, making data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns, enhance customer experiences, and maximize ROI.

Here’s What We're Looking For

12+ years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably in the enterprise technology sector with a focus on technical products, APIs, and SDKs. AI-Native builder.Passionate about empowerment: 5+ years of proven success in building and leading enterprise marketing teams across multiple disciplines, with a track record of leading, mentoring, and motivating a team to drive revenue growth.Domain expert: Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies, content marketing, and marketing automation tools. You have an analytical mindset, excel at data-driven decision-making and in leveraging marketing technologies.Excellent communication skills: You enjoy communicating both verbally and in writing with a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders.Technical acumen: You’ve marketed AI, API, and SaaS products that are built for developers and are able to effectively convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.Bias for action: Bring grit, a willingness to roll up your sleeves, and be a hands-on help to your team, not just a facilitator. Be the entrepreneurial player/coach who is a resourceful, not reliant leader.Impeccable execution: You have a track record of executing and delivering high quality work against complexities and limited resources. You’re able to partner with cross-functional teams to drive results. Other leaders and teammates love collaborating with you.Bonus: You have prior payroll or fintech experience.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $186,400yr to $248,533/yr in Scottsdale & most remote locations, and $219,600/yr - $292,800/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

headofgrowthmarketingmistercarwash.description:
Mister Car Wash is rewriting the rules of the car wash industry. Headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, we are the nation's largest and fastest growing multibillion dollar car wash company with over 500 car washes in 21 states! 




We wash cars for the fun of it. We put people first. We help turn jobs into careers.




We're currently seeking a Head of Growth Marketing to join our Headquarters team!




The Head of Growth Marketing is responsible for accelerating profitable customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value across a national footprint of car wash locations. This leader will own a full funnel paid media strategy, agency management, performance analytics, and cross-functional storytelling that connects marketing investment to incremental trips, sales, and membership growth. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of driving sustainable growth through data-backed paid media investment, while understanding the importance of brand and power of creative to drive efficiency. They thrive in a fast-paced environment and have experience with subscription or membership-based businesses with a nationwide retail footprint.



What You Will Do:




Media Strategy & Execution: 





 Own the brand's full funnel media strategy, including channel mix, budget allocation, pacing, and creative/messaging frameworks.
 Manage the media agency, including daily KPI, campaign, and budget oversight to ensure the highest level of agency execution and spend efficiency.
 Oversee daily and weekly optimizations and budget allocation across all channels (paid social, search, video, display, OOH, audio, direct mail, and emerging platforms).
 Drive an optimized mix of single retail washes and membership conversions, ensuring media supports both short-term revenue and long-term customer value.
 Partner with internal and external creative teams to ensure that paid creative is both brand-aligned and performance optimized to drive a compelling and differentiated Mister story across channels.



Performance Measurement & Analytics:



 Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reporting dashboards that clearly communicate performance vs goals, and indicate recommended actions.
 Analyze channel-level and campaign-level performance to identify opportunities to improve ROAS, CAC, CPP, and Comp Store Sales growth.
 Prove the financial impact of media investment by measuring incremental trips, incremental revenue, and membership growth.
 Collaborate with Finance and Data Science to refine marketing measurement, including attribution models, incrementality testing, and forecasting.



Consumer & Digital Experience Insights:



 Map user journeys across paid media channels and digital properties (website, app, search, maps, organic social) to identify friction points and partner with Product, Operations, and CX to improve conversion and retention.
 Leverage first-party data, CRM insights, and membership behavior to inform targeting, segmentation, and personalization strategies.



Executive Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership:



 Prepare and deliver executive level presentations that translate complex performance data into clear narratives and business recommendations.
 Partner closely with Operations, Finance, Creative, and Technology teams to ensure marketing strategies align with business priorities.
 Serve as a thought leader on growth marketing best practices, testing frameworks, and emerging media opportunities.



Note: The job duties above provide a general sense of the role; though, additional duties may be assigned as necessary.



How You Will Shine:




Education:



 Bachelor's degree preferred.
 Ongoing professional development in growth marketing, performance media, analytics, or digital strategy is strongly encouraged.



Experience:



 7-10+ years in growth marketing, performance marketing, or media strategy roles.
 Experience scaling subscription or membership models (e.g., fitness, automotive services, retail clubs, telecom).
 Deep understanding of regional media planning and multimarket execution.
 Expertise in full funnel media channels, including paid search, paid social, programmatic, video/CTV, audio, OOH, and direct response tactics.
 Strong command of performance metrics, including ROAS, CAC, CPP, LTV, Comp Store Sales, and incrementality measurement/testing.



Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:



 7-10+ years in growth marketing, performance marketing, or media strategy roles.
 Experience scaling subscription or membership models (e.g., fitness, automotive services, retail clubs, telecom).
 Deep understanding of regional media planning and multimarket execution.
 Expertise in full funnel media channels, including paid search, paid social, programmatic, video/CTV, audio, OOH, and direct response tactics.
 Strong command of performance metrics, including ROAS, CAC, CPP, LTV, Comp Store Sales, and incrementality measurement/testing audiences.


What motivates our team: 





 Excellent Benefits including medical, vision, dental, PTO, 401k, etc.
 Career Progression with a high growth.
 Modern office space in the heart of downtown Tucson.
 On-site Fitness Gym and Bike Share.
 Employee Game Room and Lounge.
 Free Unlimited Wash Club Membership.


It's your time to SHINE! Join the Mister Car Wash team today!

contentmarketingstrategisthexagonminingi.title: Content Marketing Strategist
contentmarketingstrategisthexagonminingi.description:
Hexagon’s Mining division is seeking a Content Marketing Strategist to help shape and create compelling content for audiences around the world.

This is a hands-on content role for a marketer and storyteller who understands how to turn complex ideas, customer challenges, and technology into clear, engaging narratives. Working across written, video, digital, and social channels, you will help develop content that supports Hexagon’s business priorities, strengthens our brand, and connects with customers.

Video will be an important part of the role, from identifying and developing stories to scripting, shooting, editing, and distribution. But it is one tool in a broader content mix. We are looking for someone who thinks first about the audience, the story, and the business objective, then determines the best way to bring that story to life.

You will work with colleagues, customers, and partners around the world and will have considerable autonomy to identify content opportunities, develop ideas, and manage projects from concept through delivery.

Job responsibilities

Support the development and execution of content strategies aligned with marketing, communications, product, campaign, and business priorities.Identify strong stories and translate complex technical and business subjects into clear, audience-focused content.Develop content across multiple formats and channels, including video, customer stories, articles, campaign content, product marketing materials, social media, and digital platforms.Lead video projects from concept to delivery, including research, story development, scripting and storyboarding, filming, editing, distribution, and measurement.Work directly with customers, subject-matter experts, product managers, sales teams, executives, and marketing colleagues to uncover insights and develop credible, relevant stories.Apply strong copywriting and editorial judgement to ensure content is concise, engaging, accurate, and appropriate for its intended audience.Ensure content aligns with Hexagon's brand identity, messaging, product positioning, and tone of voice.Identify opportunities to repurpose, adapt, and optimise existing content across channels and audiences, prioritising quality and relevance over volume.Use content and campaign performance data to understand audience engagement, assess effectiveness, and recommend improvements.Manage multiple content projects simultaneously, from initial brief through stakeholder review, production, publication, and measurement.Manage external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when specialist skills or additional capacity are required.Contribute ideas and recommendations that help evolve Hexagon Mining's content and video strategy.Knowledge and Experience - Required:

5+ years of professional experience in content marketing, communications, brand marketing, journalism, or a related field, preferably within a B2B, technology, industrial, engineering, or similarly complex environment.A Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.Strong storytelling and copywriting skills, with the ability to find the human and business story within complex or technical subject matter.Experience working in mining, technology, industrial, engineering, or another complex B2B environment.Demonstrated experience developing content as part of broader campaigns, product launches, customer marketing, or communications programmes.Practical video production experience, including storyboarding, scripting, filming, and editing.Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software, with the ability to adapt to Premiere Pro.Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

Experience creating content in collaboration with customers and turning customer experiences into compelling stories.Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or production vendors across different markets.Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud beyond Premiere Pro, including tools such as After Effects, Photoshop, or Audition.Photography and on-location video production experience.Experience using marketing and customer data to understand customer behaviour, identify audience or content insights, and inform content strategy and decision-making.Experience analysing content performance and translating data into practical recommendations for future content and campaigns.Spanish or Portuguese language skills alongside professional-level English.Formal education in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline.Travel

International travel, including travel to customer and mine sites may be required.


What success looks like

You will bring together marketing judgment, storytelling, and practical content creation skills to produce work that serves a clear purpose. You will be comfortable moving between strategy and execution: discussing a business priority with stakeholders one day, interviewing a customer or filming on location the next, and then shaping that material into content for multiple channels.

Most importantly, you will understand that effective content starts with the audience and the problem we are trying to solve — not the format we want to produce.

About Hexagon

Hexagon is the global leader in measurement technologies. We provide the confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate. From microns to Mars, our solutions ensure productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability in everything from manufacturing and construction to mining and autonomous systems.

Hexagon's Mining division connects the physical and digital worlds of a mine, helping customers make better-informed decisions across the mining lifecycle. Our technologies support safer operations, improved productivity, and better use of resources from mine planning and operations through to processing.

You'll own a wide portfolio: traditional media and product reviews, always-on earned coverage, an earned influencer program, thought leadership positioning, a technology analyst relations program, and an increasingly important presence on Reddit. Multi-Category PR Strategy

Media Relations & Product Reviews

Earned Influencer Program

Reddit Strategy & Community Engagement

Develop our organic Reddit presence with a long-term credibility-first mindset.Identify the right subreddits, engage authentically, manage AMAs and community moments, and equip internal subject-matter experts to participate effectively.Monitor sentiment and surface community insights that inform broader messaging.


Thought Leadership & Analyst Relations

Develop and execute a thought leadership PR program that positions Samsung's Home Entertainment business and its leaders across media, speaking platforms, and industry forums.Build and manage relationships with key industry analysts across relevant research firms, developing a structured briefing and inquiry cadence


Agency & Stakeholder Management

Manage day-to-day relationships with PR agencies — setting clear briefs, establishing performance expectations, and holding partners accountable to quality and results.Serve as the central communications connector between local and global stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, R&D, Sales, and broader marketing leadership, ensuring priorities are aligned and Samsung's voice is amplified consistently across markets.

8–12 years of PR or communications experience, with at least 3 years managing multi-program or multi-category portfoliosProven track record securing coverage in top-tier technology and consumer media outletsHands-on experience running influencer programs with a strong preference for earned over paid approachesDirect experience with analyst relations — you know how to brief, build rapport, and move the needle in reportsGenuine fluency with Reddit — you understand community norms, know where not to step, and can develop a credible brand voice organicallyStrong editorial instincts: you can write, edit, and sharpen messaging at speedExperience managing agencies and/or direct reportsComfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment; you bring structure without over-engineering it

digitalmarketingcommunicationsspecialist.description:
OFFICE OF ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITY
The Arizona Office of Economic Opportunity's mission is to strengthen Arizona’s workforce and economy.





DIGITAL MARKETING & COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST




Job Location:





Address: 1400 West Washington Street,
Phoenix, Arizona 85007





Posting Details:





Salary: $82,000.00 - $88,000.00 Annually 


Grade: 23


Closing Date: October 10, 2026





Job Summary:





The Digital Marketing & Communications Specialist (Administrative Project Manager 2) will report to the agency deputy director and be responsible for supporting strategic communication, marketing and public relations in support of the Office of Economic Opportunity’s programs and initiatives. This position will translate complex economic data, policy initiatives, and strategic objectives into clear, engaging, and accessible narratives for a diverse range of stakeholders, including businesses, policymakers, and the all Arizonans. This role is responsible for end-to-end digital content creation, multi-channel distribution, email marketing, social media management, and the development of high-impact executive presentations that align with the Director’s priorities and the agency's 5-year strategic vision. 

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.


The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.







Job Duties:





• Manages agency multi-Channel Content Creation & Distribution: Drafts, designs, edits, and schedules high-volume external digital content, including weekly/monthly email newsletters, pass advisories, media releases, and educational materials supporting OEO programs; ensures all digital assets, documents, and multimedia content strictly adhere to federal and state accessibility standards (including Section 508 compliance and WCAG guidelines); and maintains rigid alignment with official State of Arizona and OEO branding guidelines across all public-facing materials. This includes working with and assisting with supervising contracted vendors including marketing and public relations firms. 
• Executive Narrative & Visual Storytelling: Translates complex workforce development strategy, labor market information, economic policy data, and statewide strategic objectives into highly polished, high-impact PowerPoint or other types of presentations to external audiences; serves as the lead architect and custodian for all agency slide decks, ensuring visual and branding consistency and narrative clarity; and collaborates closely with agency leadership to ensure all presentation content directly reflects the agency leadership priorities, official brand standards, and the agency's 5-year strategic vision.
• Email Marketing & List Management: Manages the agency's enterprise email distribution and marketing platforms (e.g. SendGrid); oversees subscriber list health, execution of data hygiene practices, and strategic audience segmentation to maximize engagement and ensure targeted delivery of all agency external communications; and monitors and analyzes email metrics (open rates, CTRs, bounce rates) to continuously optimize campaign effectiveness.
• Social Media Management & Digital Monitoring: Maintains and executes the agency's daily active presence across primary social media platforms including X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram; develops and maintains a comprehensive digital content calendar to ensure a steady stream of information regarding Arizona's economic growth; monitors digital channels for public inquiries, industry trends, and media mentions, escalating sensitive issues to leadership as appropriate; and interacts with key stakeholders and responds to incoming messages on a timely basis across agency contact inbox and social media direct messages
• Other duties as assigned as related to the position including: Supports OEO webinars, town halls, press conferences, or public events across the state; and participates in cross-agency communications workgroups within the State of Arizona enterprise.







Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):





Knowledge of:

• Principles, theories, and practices of public relations, digital marketing, and strategic communications within a government or public sector environment;
• Digital accessibility laws, specifically Section 508 compliance and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards);
• Graphic design principles, visual storytelling techniques, and data visualization
• Email marketing best practices, list management, and platform logistics (e.g., SendGrid);
• Current trends, algorithms, and best practices for professional social media platforms (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram).

Skills in:

• Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint design, including template creation, data integration, and narrative structuring for executive audiences;
• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate dense economic data into plain language;
• Basic graphic design tools (e.g., Canva) and content management systems;
• Audience segmentation and data analytics for email and social media campaigns;
• Project management, multitasking, and meeting tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Ability to: 

• Effectively synthesize complex policy objectives into cohesive, visually compelling presentations;
• Maintain absolute confidentiality and exercise impeccable judgment when handling sensitive economic data or executive messaging;
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships across all levels of the agency, including executive leadership and external stakeholders;
• Adapt quickly to shifting priorities, breaking news, or changing directive mandates from the Director’s office.







Selective Preference(s):





• A Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Graphic Design, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
• Experience managing communications or public information for a state, local, or federal government agency. 
• Demonstrated experience creating data-heavy executive presentations (PowerPoint portfolios may be requested). 
• Technical proficiency with SendGrid or comparable enterprise email marketing systems. Certified knowledge of Section 508/accessible design.







Pre-Employment Requirements:





• Two (2) years of professional experience in digital content creation, public relations, or marketing.
• Professional experience in professional communications roles may substitute for the required degree on a year-for-year basis.


If this position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job to conduct State business, then the following requirements apply: Driver’s License Requirements.



All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify).







Benefits:





The State of Arizona offers a comprehensive benefits package to include:
• Sick leave
• Vacation with 10 paid holidays per year
• Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program)
• Health and dental insurance
• Retirement plan
• Life insurance and long-term disability insurance
• Optional employee benefits include short-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance


By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion.


Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our benefits page







Retirement:





• Positions in this classification participate in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS)
• Please note, enrollment eligibility will become effective after 27 weeks of employment







Contact Us:





If you have any questions please feel free to contact Rose Ibe at rose.ibe@azdoa.gov.

This position can be worked remotely anywhere in the United States for the right candidate.  Candidates must be U.S. Citizens.


Reporting to the Internal Communications strategic lead for HR, you will translate communications strategy into coordinated campaigns that help employees understand their benefits, develop their careers, navigate change and connect with SAIC. You will partner closely with HR teams and Corporate Communications to manage content, deadlines, approvals and publishing across employee channels.

What We’re Looking For



 Demonstrated experience delivering employee communications and managing multiple campaigns in a complex organization.

 Strong project management and organizational skills, including ownership of calendars, deadlines, review processes and deliverables.

 Experience communicating with a distributed workforce, including employees working at customer sites.

 A creative mindset and a practical approach to solving problems and improving workflows.
 Comfort learning new communications and marketing tools, including FirstUp and MarketScale, and applying them to day-to-day campaign delivery.
 Ability to interpret email and campaign metrics, identify patterns and recommend changes that improve employee engagement and action.
		 

 
		Qualifications

94eradioandcommunicationssecurityrepaire.description:
Job Description

It’s extremely important that Army National Guard communications don’t fall into the wrong hands. As the Radio and Communications Security Repairer, you will maintain the equipment and systems that ensure Army National Guard units can communicate over secure channels.

Your duties will include installing and repairing circuits and wiring, calibrating and aligning equipment components, and stringing overhead cables between utility poles. Other duties include repairing systems, performing equipment tests, and performing preventive maintenance checks and services on equipment.

Advanced Radio and Communications Security Repairers take on more challenging projects, including training and supervising other Soldiers, testing equipment, performing complex repairs, and ensuring that the National Security Agency-approved components are used in communication security/controlled cryptographic item repairs.

Job Duties

 Use test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment; test program sets and interactive electronic technical manuals to troubleshoot and repair equipment

Some Of The Skills You’ll Learn

 Communication security policy and procedure

Helpful Skills

 Strong attention to detail

Through your training, you will develop the skills and experience to enjoy a civilian career in radio repair, radio mechanics, teletype repair, or station installation.

Earn While You Learn

Instead of paying to learn these skills, get paid to train. In the Army National Guard, you will learn these valuable job skills while earning a regular paycheck and qualifying for tuition assistance.

After 10 weeks of Basic Training, where you will learn fundamental Soldiering skills, you will attend Advanced Individual Training (AIT) for 16 weeks of classroom instruction, including practice with equipment. You will learn mechanical, electronic, and electrical principles, preventive maintenance procedures, and communication security policies and procedures.

Benefits/Requirements

Benefits

Paid trainingA monthly paycheckMontgomery GI BillFederal and State tuition assistanceRetirement benefits for part-time serviceLow-cost life insurance (up to $400,000 in coverage)401(k)-type savings planStudent Loan Repayment Program (up to $50,000, for existing loans)Health care benefits availableVA home loansBonuses, if applicableMost non-prior service candidates will earn between $200 and $250 per drill weekend, subject to change

Requirements

Overview


  Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


  The American Heart Association has an exciting opportunity for a Marketing Communications Director serving the Nevada and Southern Arizona Division teams.


  This hybrid role may be based in Las Vegas, NV, or Tucson, AZ, with work taking place across home office, community, and office settings to support marketing, communications, and mission-driven initiatives.


  The Marketing Communications Director develops and implements strategic communications, marketing, media relations, and public relations initiatives for the American Heart Association across the Nevada and Southern, while providing communications support for other territories as needed. This role advances the American Heart Association’s position as the leading authority on cardiovascular health and science through integrated external and internal communications, marketing campaigns, media outreach, digital strategies, sponsorship activation, and special initiatives.


  The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


  #TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.


  Responsibilities


  Brand Integrity


  
   Maintains the integrity of the brand and identity of the American Heart Association by developing and/or reviewing/editing communications and marketing materials.
  
  Traditional and Digital Media


  
   
    Raise visibility of the Division via traditional and digital media outlets. Maintain and steward existing media relationships. Explore and engage new outlets, especially media with reach to targeted audiences. Research and monitor new/burgeoning media, especially those being developed in the Las Vegas and Tucson markets.


   
    Seeks, cultivates, and maintains regional media relationships, with traditional and emerging media.


   
    Secures formal media partnerships/sponsorships for various events, campaigns and cause initiatives as appropriate.


   
    Pitches “big picture” stories, focusing on hard news, feature and research stories, to Las Vegas and Tucson markets.


   
    Researches and prepares media and background materials to support American Heart Association policy issues and community programs.


   
    Develops fast response mechanism for hard news stories. Alerts field staff with media advisories and cause/marketing activities as appropriate.


  
  Overall Campaign Development and Traction


  
   
    Work closely with internal partners to be an innovator and market disruptor. Seek new approaches to transforming sponsorship communications and marketing deliverables. Steward current sponsorships and expand into new industries. Help craft mission-focused proposals and weave in media, marketing and messaging themes to fully complement our campaigns. Contribute to campaign revenue through health asset sponsorships/activations.


   
    Develops and submits proposals outlining the details of the partnerships/sponsorships.


   
    Supports day-of event activities.


  
  Elevate Visibility of Local Divisions as Engaged Community Stakeholders


  
   
    To truly make an impact, each market needs to be widely recognized as a trusted and reliable stakeholder. We are invested in the overall health of the communities we serve.


   
    Implements communications plans with media advocacy, public policy initiatives and media spokespeople. Contributes to volunteer leadership, including helping identify and recruit potential committee and board members.


   
    Identifies, recruits and trains volunteers who can serve as media and cause initiative spokespersons. Maintains an accessible database of human interest stories to tap for media inquiries.


   
    Develops and executes social media strategy in conjunction with digital staff.


   
    Works with internal and external partners to produce mission-focused content for organic social channels.


   
    Plans and executes paid social media campaigns.


   
    Develops, in conjunction with field staff and volunteers, and oversees implementation of communications and marketing plans.


   
    Works with internal partners to ensure effective local implementation of field-related communications and marketing activities.


   
    Works with external media partners to plan and execute advertising campaigns.


   
    Serves as communications and marketing consultant to staff and volunteers, including conducting communications orientation and training, monitoring progress on key objectives and cause initiatives, and providing general counsel and guidance.


   
    Coordinates, in conjunction with National Center and Western States communications and marketing staff, communications- and marketing-related promotions, mailings, distribution, and reporting.


  
  Qualifications


  
   
    3 years minimum prior related experience with:


   
    Knowledge of variety of mass and alternative media, and principles of journalism including news gathering, interviewing, writing and editing. Basic video, graphic design and photography skills desired.


   
    Experience in communications, marketing, or public affairs with a background in journalism, public relations, marketing, advertising or similar position.


   
    Knowledge and experience with the fundamentals of multiple disciplines are needed, including the principles and ethics of public relations, promotion, marketing and business communications.


   
    Demonstrated excellence in written communications skills, including news, business, and persuasive writing.


   
    Demonstrated skills in effective one-on-one and group communications and work with all levels of media contacts, community leaders, and American Heart Association volunteers and staff.


   
    Ability to deal professionally in a corporate and non-profit environment and assume responsibility for guiding communications and marketing projects and programs from inception through completion.


   
    Demonstrated ability to simultaneously manage multiple, complex projects in varying stages of development under time pressure.


   
    Knowledge and experience with developing content for event collateral materials.


   
    University/College degree or equivalent experience.


  
  Here are some of the preferred skills we are looking for:


  
   
    Knowledge of the principles and practices of strategic planning, budgeting, and managing work.


   
    Knowledge of basic fund-raising principles, practices, and techniques.


   
    Knowledge of American Heart Association’s mission and programs.


  
  Compensation & Benefits


  Expected pay range will be $64,575 to $86,205 annually. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.


  The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.


  
   
    Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.


   
    Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.


   
    Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.


   
    Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.


   
    Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.


   
    Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.


  
  The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.


  At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

marketinggeneralistcommunityfoodbankofso.description:
Function: The Marketing Generalist is part of the Marketing team and provides broad support across the Community Food Bank’s (CFB), marketing and communications activities. This position assists with content development, digital communication, social media, advertising, graphic design, website updates, multimedia, and other marketing initiatives. The Marketing Generalist collaborates with internal partners across the organization to help develop relevant and engaging communications for the communities that CFB serves.


 Duties and Responsibilities: 


 
  
   Creates and supports marketing and communications content across digital, print, social media, web, email, multimedia, and other channels.


  
   Conducts interviews with clients, donors, volunteers, staff, community partners, and members of the public to identify and develop compelling stories that advance the Community Food Bank’s mission.


  
   Writes, edits, and proofreads content for internal and external communications, in alignment with organizational messaging and brand standards.


  
   Helps create and maintain engaging digital content across the organization’s website, social media platforms, email communications, and other web-based channels.


  
   Supports the development and execution of integrated marketing and communications campaigns using traditional and digital channels, including multilingual communications as needed.


  
   Coordinates advertising activities with media outlets and vendors, including newspapers, websites, television, radio, social media, and other digital platforms.


  
   Researches advertising opportunities, marketing channels, tools, and emerging trends and shares findings with Marketing leadership.


  
   Coordinates print production with designated vendors, including requesting quotes, submitting print-ready files, tracking orders, and ensuring timely delivery.


  
   Processes marketing vendor invoices, secures appropriate approvals, maintains expense records, and tracks translation-related expenses and budgets.


  
   Creates and adapts graphics and visual assets for print and digital communications using Adobe Creative Suite and established brand guidelines and templates.


  
   Supports video production, editing, motion graphics, photography, and other multimedia projects.

   Supports website content management, including creating, editing, and updating content within the organization’s CMS.

   Stays current on marketing, communications, digital, social media, design, and industry trends and identifies opportunities to incorporate new tools, platforms, and approaches into the organization’s work.

 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 


 
  
   Knowledge of integrated marketing principles and practices, including content marketing, social media, digital marketing, advertising, and media planning.


  
   Knowledge of digital communications and web-based environments, including content management systems, social media platforms, email marketing, and blogging platforms.


  
   Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and experience creating graphics and other visual content for both print and digital applications.


  
   Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, with the ability to write effectively for a variety of audiences and channels.


  
   Experience with website analytics and reporting tools, such as Google Analytics.


  
   Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, vendors, and priorities simultaneously.


  
   Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and move projects forward with minimal direction.


  
   Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, vendors, community partners, and individuals across diverse departments and areas of expertise.


  
   Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, platforms, tools, and marketing practices.


  
   Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to professional growth and incorporating new information into day-to-day work.


  
   Ability to communicate and work effectively with people from diverse economic, social, cultural, and political backgrounds

   A high school diploma or equivalent.


  
   Three (3) years of experience in Marketing, Advertising or Communications.
