marketingspecialistproemoperationsllc.title: Marketing Specialist
marketingspecialistproemoperationsllc.description:
Job Summary:

PRO EM National Event Services is a national leader in large-scale event production, providing tents, staging, flooring, and turn-key event solutions for sporting events, concerts and festivals, corporate events, weddings, construction and government clients across the country. As PRO EM continues to grow, the Marketing Specialist will own day-to-day execution of the company's marketing efforts and serve as the primary point of contact for PRO EM's outside marketing strategist and content partners, translating their strategic direction into content, campaigns, and sales enablement materials. This is a hands-on execution role, not a strategy-setting role, reporting to PRO EM's marketing leadership.

Responsibilities

•       Reports to PRO EM's marketing leadership

•       Own day-to-day execution of PRO EM's marketing plan and content calendar, translating direction from leadership and PRO EM's outside marketing strategist/consultant into action

•       Serve as the primary point of contact for PRO EM's outside content, social media, and creative partners, briefing priorities and reviewing deliverables for brand and quality before they go out

•       Lead creation and scheduling of content across social media, the website, email marketing, and paid social channels

•       Develop and manage marketing and sales enablement materials (proposals, brochures, spec sheets, case studies, presentations) in partnership with the sales team

•       Manage on-site photo and video content capture at client events, building a consistent library across sports, concerts, festivals, corporate, and social events

•       Own website content updates and basic SEO hygiene within PRO EM's existing content management system

•       Coordinate PRO EM's presence at industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events

•       Track and report on marketing performance metrics (web traffic, lead generation, social engagement, campaign ROI), and flag trends or recommendations to leadership

•       Help maintain brand consistency across every region, business line, and outside partner's work

•       Support public relations efforts, including drafting press release copy, fielding routine media inquiries, and compiling award submissions

•       Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements

•       Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

•       4-6 years of progressive marketing experience, including content creation, social media, and campaign execution

•       Demonstrated experience coordinating or managing outside agencies, freelancers, or vendors

•       Comfortable working within a website content management system; familiarity with graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar) a plus

•       Solid working knowledge of digital marketing channels (SEO/SEM, paid social, email marketing) and analytics tools such as Google Analytics

•       Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to represent the PRO EM brand to clients, partners, and the public

•       Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and regional priorities at once

•       Comfortable taking strategic direction from outside partners and translating it into content and campaigns with minimal oversight

•       Experience in events, live entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry preferred

•       Comfortable traveling to event sites and regional offices as needed

•       Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends to support live events

enterpriseclientmarketingmanagervanguard.title: Enterprise Client Marketing Manager
enterpriseclientmarketingmanagervanguard.description:
The Client Marketing Manager, Enterprise Client Marketing is responsible for supporting the development and execution of integrated marketing initiatives in support of the cross-divisional Enterprise Client Group. This individual will help strengthen relationships with priority enterprise clients through coordinated engagement programs, differentiated client experiences, thought leadership, and a unified enterprise presence. The role will focus on executing marketing initiatives that deepen loyalty, strengthen relationships, create opportunities for collaboration, and support business growth across the firm's most important client relationships. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to the firm's most important client relationships through marketing execution, project management, event delivery, content activation, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will play a critical role in bringing enterprise marketing strategies to life while ensuring a high-quality experience for clients and internal stakeholders.

We're building a new Enterprise Client Marketing team focused on deepening relationships with some of Vanguard's most important institutional clients. These roles offer the opportunity to shape executive engagement strategies, create compelling thought leadership programs, and deliver marquee client experiences that influence C-suite leaders at major organizations. Whether you're a seasoned marketing strategist or a hands-on marketing professional, you'll help establish the foundation of a growing function while partnering across sales, marketing, and leadership teams to drive business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement and Marketing Execution

The Client Marketing Manager will support the execution of integrated marketing initiatives designed to strengthen relationships with priority enterprise clients and senior decision-makers. The role will assist in translating marketing priorities into actionable plans and ensuring successful delivery of key initiatives.

Differentiated Client Experiences and Event Execution

The Client Marketing Manager will support the planning and execution of high-impact client experiences, including executive forums, client councils, hospitality programs, regional events, and other executive engagement opportunities. The role will be responsible for coordinating program logistics, managing project plans and timelines, partnering with internal and external vendors, and ensuring seamless execution of client experiences.

Thought Leadership and Content Activation

The Client Marketing Manager will support the development and activation of thought leadership initiatives that reinforce the firm's position as a trusted, insight-driven partner for C-suite executives and key influencers. The individual will help ensure content reaches the appropriate audiences and supports broader client engagement objectives.

Program Coordination

The Client Marketing Manager will support multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously and help drive effective execution across the Enterprise Client Marketing function. The role will help maintain planning processes, project timelines, and operational disciplines that support quality, consistency, and efficiency.

Required Qualifications

The ideal candidate should have:




Minimum five years related work experience.Undergraduate degree in Marketing or equivalent experience required.Understanding of asset management, investment solutions, client segments, and enterprise-level clients. Experience in FAS or Workplace Solutions preferred.Experience supporting the execution of integrated marketing campaigns, client engagement programs, or strategic marketing initiatives.Experience planning and coordinating events, executive forums, hospitality programs, conferences, or other client-facing experiences.Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.Strong written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.


This role is part of our hybrid work model with a required three days a week onsite (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) in the following locations: Malvern PA; Charlotte, NC; Dallas (Plano), TX; Scottsdale, AZ. Fully remote work is not available for this role.

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

digitalmarketingspecialistecommercespeci.title: Digital Marketing Specialist / E-commerce Specialist
digitalmarketingspecialistecommercespeci.description:
Job Summary


We are seeking an energetic and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Specialist / E-commerce Specialist to lead our online marketing initiatives and drive our digital sales growth. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize comprehensive digital marketing campaigns across multiple platforms, ensuring maximum engagement and conversion. Your expertise in SEO, paid advertising, content creation, and website management will be pivotal in elevating our brand presence and achieving measurable results. This paid position offers a dynamic environment where innovation and strategic thinking are celebrated.


Responsibilities



 Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns utilizing tools such as Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, and marketing automation platforms to boost brand visibility and sales.
 Manage and optimize e-commerce platforms, including website management through WordPress and content management systems, ensuring a seamless user experience.
 Conduct keyword research using SEO tools to improve organic search rankings and implement on-page SEO strategies aligned with current best practices.
 Create compelling content for websites, social media channels, email marketing campaigns, and digital ads that resonate with target audiences.
 Analyze web analytics data using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and other reporting tools to monitor performance metrics and generate actionable insights.
 Implement conversion optimization techniques through A/B testing, landing page enhancements, and user experience improvements to maximize ROI on paid advertising campaigns.
 Oversee social media management by planning, executing, and analyzing social media advertising campaigns across platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and others.

 Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEM (Search Engine Marketing), paid search marketing (Google AdWords), social media advertising campaigns, and web analytics reporting.
 Proficiency in SEO tools, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Advertising Manager, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator), and Adobe Photoshop for content creation.
 Technical skills including HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics, website management on WordPress or similar CMS platforms, and familiarity with marketing automation tools.
 Experience managing e-commerce platforms with knowledge of product listing optimization and user experience enhancements.
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data from web analytics reports to inform strategy adjustments.
 Excellent communication skills for creating engaging content and collaborating across teams on digital campaign setup and performance marketing initiatives.
 Ability to stay current with evolving digital marketing trends including SEO best practices, paid advertising strategies, and emerging social media platforms.

Join us to leverage your digital marketing expertise in a fast-paced environment where your innovative ideas will directly impact our growth!


Pay: $18.00 - $21.00 per hour


Work Location: In person

Position Summary

As a key member of Phoenix Children’s Marketing team, the Branding and Consumer Strategies Manager plays an integral role in marketing Phoenix Children’s physicians and other providers, medical specialties, facilities and other offerings to acquire new patients, retain existing ones, enhance loyalty and build the brand. This professional develops and executes strategic marketing plans to increase revenue and profitability of Phoenix Children’s. This professional also serves as the point person for all system branding initiatives, including the branding agency relationship. Reporting to the Director of Consumer Strategies, this professional also serves as the marketing point-person for Phoenix Children’s professional sports partnerships, as well as high school and sports league programs.

Position Duties
 Annual Marketing & Communications Plan


I. Develops and executes the annual service line strategic marketing plan(s), with distinct focus on patient acquisition and retention, utilizing financial, operational and market share data and analytics to prioritize efforts and to develop goals, strategies and KPIs.

II. Maintains accountability for overall quality of marketing strategy, plans and execution.

III. Manages all service line digital content (including online physician bios) and social media content, including blogs.

IV. Oversees mystery shopping initiatives of their respective service line(s), as well as the reporting of results and follow-up strategies to enhance the consumer experience.

V. Serves as the Marketing point of contact for non-COE key service line(s) and a minimum of 4 other medical programs and services.

 Ad Campaigns & Other Key Marketing Initiatives


I. Serves as the point of contact for the respective service line(s) operational and physician leadership. This individual manages the development and execution of all multi-channel advertising, marketing, web and social media campaigns and other key marketing initiatives.

II. Collaborates with agency and internal resources to develop compelling creative that promotes consumer awareness, interest, engagement and acquisition.

III. Crafts and manages timely contribution and distribution of social media campaign content (paid and unpaid) in coordination with overarching campaign goals and strategies.

IV. Oversees operational readiness before the launch of any ad/marketing campaign to ensure a seamless patient journey. Must be able to pivot due to changes in access or quality, or a significant increase/decrease in volumes.

V. Working under the direction of the Director of Marketing, this professional continually analyzes and monitors industry and service line trends.

 Branding


I. Serves as the marketing project manager of Phoenix Children’s rebranding initiatives, including the day-to-day contact with the branding agency of record.

 Sports Partnerships


I. Is the point of contact and marketing lead for all professional sports sponsorships and all sports activation and community strategies, and all sports sponsorships of all community schools and leagues.

II. Manages agency relationship(s) that assess(es) potential opportunities or sponsorships.

 Budget & Monitoring


I. Develops and manages service line marketing budget.

II. Is responsible for tracking and measuring all campaigns/activities; provides quarterly reports to service line operational leaders, physicians and other key stakeholders.

 Performs miscellaneous job related duties as requested. 


Phoenix Children's Mission, Vision, & Values

To advance hope, healing and the best healthcare for children and their families

We realize this vision by:

Offering the most comprehensive care across ages, communities and specialtiesInvesting in innovative research, including emerging treatments, tools and technologiesAdvancing education and training to shape the next generation of clinical leadersAdvocating for the health and well-being of children and families

Position Overview
  
    Arizona Sports Enterprises (ASE), the sponsorship and NIL arm of Arizona Athletics, is seeking a Director Partnership Marketing to lead the strategy, execution, and fulfillment of all corporate partnerships. You will also manage and develop the Partnership Marketing team, oversee the sponsorship lifecycle, and serve as a strategic partner to sales, campus stakeholders, and senior leadership. The ideal candidate demonstrates leadership, operational rigor, and creative problem-solving with the ability to scale processes while preserving a high-touch partner experience.

    Leadership & Team Management:
      
        Lead, coach, and develop the Partnership Marketing team to ensure consistent, high-quality partner service.
        Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance feedback, and professional development planning.
        Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
        Serve as a resource to troubleshoot and resolve activation challenges in real time.
      
    
    Partnership Marketing & Activation:
      
        Own the activation and fulfillment strategy for all corporate partnerships across Arizona Athletics.
        Manage the full sponsorship lifecycle, including onboarding, execution, measurement, and renewal support.

        Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate partners to support renewals and long-term growth.
        Develop scalable activation frameworks, timelines, and recap materials for internal and external use.

        Collaborate with internal Athletics and campus stakeholders (Ticketing, Marketing, Communications, Game Operations, Community Impact, NIL, Legal, Procurement, Licensing, Digital, Media Relations, and Compliance) to streamline approvals and ensure execution accuracy.

        Develop and manage a comprehensive activation calendar across all partners and sports.
        Oversee onboarding and training of new Partnership Marketing staff.
        Continuously evaluate and improve internal processes to enhance efficiency and partner satisfaction.
        Support the development of partner recaps, case studies, and performance reporting.
        Partner with analytics resources to evaluate brand exposure, engagement, and return on objectives.

        Support renewal strategy and identification of growth opportunities within existing accounts.
        Maintain working knowledge of partner categories, exclusivities, inventory, and asset availability.

    Experience working in sports, entertainment, higher education, or a related partnership-driven environment.

    Experience in pro sports, collegiate athletics, or multi-property sponsorship environments.
    Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams.
    Experience working with CRM systems and sponsorship analytics tools.

We help merchants streamline transactions, improve day-to-day operations, and support customer-facing business workflows. As Yammii expands into selected regional markets across the U.S., we are building a regional growth team to strengthen local market presence, deepen merchant engagement, and support community-based business development. 




About the Role 

The Regional Marketing & Community Development Specialist will drive local market growth through community engagement, merchant relationships, and regional partnership development. This role is designed for candidates interested in marketing, community development, partnerships, local business growth, and startup expansion. You will help build local presence, identify merchant engagement opportunities, and create relationship-driven growth within assigned regional markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help Yammii establish trusted local connections in selected regional markets and contribute directly to the company’s regional expansion strategy. The role is well-suited for early-career professionals and high-potential candidates seeking hands-on exposure to community growth, merchant engagement, and regional market development. 




What You Will Do - Build local market presence through merchant engagement, community relationships, and partnership development - Develop relationships with merchants, student groups, business networks, and community organizations - Identify referral channels, local partnership opportunities, and community-based growth opportunities - Support merchant communication, regional outreach initiatives, and early-stage adoption efforts - Share merchant feedback, local market signals, and community insights with the internal team 




What We Look For - Interest or experience in marketing, communications, community management, partnerships, local business development, or related fields - Strong relationship-building, organization, follow-up, event coordination, or community engagement skills - Comfort working with merchants, student groups, business owners, community organizations, or local networks - Experience in event planning, student organizations, local outreach, hospitality, restaurant operations, retail, or similar activities - Professional communication ability in English and Mandarin Chinese 

Work Authorization Candidates must have valid U.S. work authorization. International students with valid work authorization are welcome to apply. Future sponsorship may be considered based on role fit and company needs. 




Compensation & Program Structure Compensation may include base pay, performance-based bonuses, business-related stipends, and approved expense reimbursement. Compensation and role scope are reviewed periodically based on individual contribution, market development progress, and business needs. For full-time conversion opportunities, the typical annual compensation package may range from $55,000 to $70,000, depending on role scope, location, performance, and business needs.

We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. You’re a hands-on B2B marketer who enjoys taking campaigns from idea through to execution and seeing the commercial impact they deliver. You know how to segment and target different audiences, create engaging campaigns and use performance data to understand what’s working and where to optimise.

Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.

With over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence, we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access, people are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role - even if your experience doesn’t tick every box - you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?

Let’s make a difference together.

Love Work. Love Life. Be You.

 An effective, integrated social function will bring together social (content, community management, creator/talent) and communications (brand public relations) to drive earned and social conversation and build brand love among fans and consumers. This role also includes the use of social intelligence to identify content opportunity areas, nurturing existing fans and recruiting new fans.

Job Title

Director, Marketing – Digital Customer Experience

Company

Prologis

A day in the life

The Director, Marketing – Digital Customer Experience will lead the strategy and evolution of Prologis’ global digital customer experience ecosystem with an AI-first transformation mindset. This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Customer Experience, Technology, Data, and AI, translating business priorities into scalable digital capabilities that improve how customers, prospects, marketers, and internal teams engage with Prologis.

The Director will own the vision and roadmap across digital experience platforms, including web and CMS, property search, digital asset management, marketing automation, analytics, personalization, conversational experiences, and AI-enabled capabilities.

A core expectation of this role is to continually reimagine Digital Customer Experience through AI, automation, and data. AI should be considered from the outset when defining new digital capabilities rather than added after solutions have been designed.

This leader will translate Prologis’ broader enterprise AI strategy into actionable Digital Customer Experience priorities and use cases, while partnering closely with Enterprise AI, Technology, Architecture, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and governance teams on shared platforms, standards, and responsible AI practices.

Location
Remote

6 months (possible extension to 12 months)


Compensation
Starting at $80/hr W2

Leadership Partnership & Communications Counsel:


Participate in relevant GSM leadership discussions and maintain visibility across major priorities and initiatives. Proactively identify communications needs and recommend the appropriate audience, message, channel, and timing.

Strong writing, editing, storytelling, and executive communications capabilities.

Job Description 

 Job Description 



 Peak Energy 

 Job Title:  Senior Manager, Communications 
 Location:  Burlingame, California (In-person)
 Department:  Marketing 
 Reports To:  Director of Growth & Marketing 
 Position Type:  Full-time 

 

 About Peak Energy 

 Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven Sodium-Ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid. 

 Sodium-Ion is cheap, readily available and safe, making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market. 

 Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners such as TDK Ventures and Eclipse Ventures. 

 We are a team of engineers, operators, entrepreneurs, and partners driven by a shared ambition to set the new performance standard for renewable energy and grid resilience. 

 

 About the Role – Senior Manager, Communications 

 Peak Energy is looking for a Senior Manager, Communications to lead corporate communications, public relations, and product storytelling. 

 You will work closely with Peak's leadership team and across Marketing, Commercial, Product, and Engineering to shape how we communicate our company, technology, and products externally. You'll turn company priorities, customer insights, and complex technical inputs into clear, compelling narratives. 

 This is a hands-on role that spans strategy and execution. You will write press releases, develop messaging and media pitches, prepare executives for interviews, shape product positioning, and lead major announcements from initial strategy through launch. 

 

 What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

 Corporate Communications & Executive Communications 

 Develop and execute Peak's corporate communications and PR strategy. 

 Work directly with executives to develop messaging, talking points, presentations, and external narratives. 

 Write press releases, media pitches, FAQs, briefing materials, and executive communications. 

 Prepare executives for media interviews, speaking engagements, and major announcements. 

 Build media relationships and proactively drive earned coverage. 

 Manage Peak's external PR agency, including priorities, pitching strategy, and performance. 

 Positioning, Content & Storytelling 

 Develop and maintain Peak's corporate, technology, and product messaging. 

 Translate technical differentiation, customer insights, and market dynamics into clear value propositions and compelling external stories. 

 Partner with Commercial, Product, and Engineering to validate proof points, customer evidence, and technical claims. 

 Develop executive thought leadership and review technical explainers, case studies, white papers, and customer-facing content to ensure messaging alignment 

 Partner with executives and subject matter experts to develop differentiated points of view on key market topics. 

 Launches & Go-to-Market Communications 

 Lead communications for product launches, customer announcements, partnerships, financing, manufacturing milestones, and other major company news. 

 Partner with Government Affairs, Product, Commercial, and Engineering to translate GTM strategy into positioning, proof points, launch narratives, and supporting materials. 

 Own communications execution from narrative and content development through media strategy and external rollout. 

 What You'll Bring (Qualifications)

6–8+ years of experience in communications, PR, product communications, or a related role. 

 Exceptional writer and editor with extensive experience writing press releases, pitches, executive messaging, and long-form content. 

 Strong media relations experience and a track record of securing meaningful earned coverage. 

 Experience working directly with senior executives and the judgment and confidence to advise leadership on messaging and external communications. 

 Experience positioning and launching technical products, technologies, or major company initiatives. 

 Ability to translate complex technical and commercial information into clear, credible narratives and customer value propositions. 

 High ownership and ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

This position is responsible for leading strategy, execution, and optimization across Banner Health's owned and organic digital marketing channels including email, social media, SEO/AEO, and emerging channels. Serves as the cross-channel orchestrator who ensures integrated, data-driven digital marketing activation that reaches audiences with coordinated messaging and optimized customer experiences. Drives measurable results through owned and organic digital channels, and by building organizational capability in a matrixed, collaborative environment.

 Leads digital marketing planning and cross-channel orchestration for integrated campaigns. Monitors social listening, sentiment, and trends. Drives audience growth, engagement, and conversion through organic social tactics. Manages social media tools, platforms, and vendor relationships.  Owns SEO/AEO strategy and organic search optimization. Develops search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) strategies to improve Banner Health's visibility in organic search results and AI-powered answer engines. Executes or directs execution of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content optimization, and local search strategies. Collaborates with Content Strategy & Operations on SEO-optimized content and with Web Production & UX on technical implementation. Conducts keyword research, competitive analysis, and search performance monitoring. Drives organic search traffic growth, search rankings improvement, and featured snippet/AI answer optimization. Manages SEO tools, platforms, and vendor relationships.  Explores and pilots emerging digital channels and innovative marketing tactics. Stays current on emerging digital platforms, channels, and marketing technologies. Evaluates new channels (e.g., TikTok, Threads, emerging social platforms) for strategic fit and audience opportunity. Pilots innovative tactics including influencer partnerships, user-generated content, interactive experiences, and new content formats. Tests emerging AI-powered marketing capabilities and automation opportunities. Recommends channel expansion or investment based on performance data and strategic alignment. Brings innovation mindset to digital marketing execution and continuous improvement.  Drives performance optimization and conversion rate improvement across digital channels. Establishes measurement frameworks, KPIs, and success metrics for all digital marketing channels. Analyzes channel performance, audience behavior, and campaign effectiveness. Identifies optimization opportunities and implements testing strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and ROI. Partners with MarTech & Digital Experience on conversion rate optimization (CRO) for bannerhealth.com, providing strategic direction for testing roadmaps. Collaborates with Consumer Insights & Marketing Operations on analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. Fosters culture of testing, learning, and continuous improvement across the digital marketing team.  Builds and leads a high-performing digital marketing team. Recruits, hires, and onboards digital marketing team members including channel specialists and program managers. Provides leadership, coaching, and professional development to build team capabilities. Sets clear goals, expectations, and performance standards. Conducts performance reviews and career development planning. Fosters collaborative, innovative team culture focused on results and continuous learning. Develops team expertise in digital marketing best practices, emerging trends, and platform capabilities. Ensures team has resources, tools, and support needed to execute effectively.  Manages digital marketing channel budgets, vendors, and agency relationships. Develops and manages budgets for digital marketing tools, platforms, and vendor services. Evaluates and selects marketing technology platforms including social media management tools, SEO platforms, email service providers, and analytics tools. Manages vendor and agency relationships for specialized services including social listening, influencer marketing, SEO consulting, and content production. Negotiates contracts, manages performance, and ensures vendor accountability. Optimizes budget allocation across channels based on performance and strategic priorities.  Partners across Consumer Digital Engagement, Marketing, and cross-functional teams to ensure integrated execution. Collaborates closely with Content Strategy & Operations to align messaging and content across channels. Partners with MarTech & Digital Experience to ensure platform enablement, data integration, and technical execution support. Coordinates with media teams to align owned, organic, and channel strategies for integrated campaigns. Works with Consumer Insights & Marketing Operations on measurement, analytics, and reporting. Engages with Brand, Compliance, and Communications to ensure brand consistency and regulatory compliance. Serves as digital marketing subject matter expert and strategic advisor to service line marketing teams and organizational leadership.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

7+ years of progressive digital marketing experience with demonstrated expertise across multiple channels including email, social media, and SEO.

5+ years of leadership experience building and managing high-performing marketing teams.

Proven track record developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies that drive measurable business results. Deep expertise in email marketing strategy, execution, and optimization including segmentation, automation, and lifecycle marketing. Strong background in organic social media marketing across multiple platforms including content strategy, community management, and audience growth. Solid understanding of SEO/AEO principles, technical SEO, content optimization, and organic search strategies. Deloitte's Marketing, Brand & Communications team is seeking a strategic external communications and public relations professional to lead PR for our Technology, Media, & Telecommunications (TMT) industry. This role will drive marketplace growth through integrated brand PR, media relations, and paid media collaboration. This role will develop and execute external communications strategies and campaigns that amplify Deloitte's highest priority growth areas, in close collaboration with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across brand, communications, and media. The successful candidate will help strengthen the Deloitte brand, elevating priority offerings and narratives, from major industry moments like the Consumer Electronics Show and Mobile World Congress to positioning leaders as trusted voices through coordinated earned and paid amplification.

The ideal candidate brings strong media relations experience, executive presence, and sound judgment under pressure, along with the ability to collaborate effectively and drive a clear, consistent narrative brand across a matrixed organization. Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills, proactivity, teamwork, and the delivery of consistently high-quality results.

Recruiting for this role ends on October 15, 2026

Responsibilities



Lead external communications and media relations for TMT and elevate Deloitte's brand storytelling via the media, working in collaboration with TMT leadership.Drive connectivity across Deloitte's highly matrixed environment to up-level storytelling opportunities.Develop stronger collaboration between paid and earned media teams, including strategy development and execution to maximize Deloitte's investments.Work collaboratively with Brand Research & Insights team to develop data-based messaging for media relations initiatives that drive the Deloitte brand forward.Advance measurement of the team's impact and value to the firm, leveraging AI tools to generate new insights into media coverage and recommending ways to evolve messaging, target key media outlets, and meet business goals.Manage external PR agency resources to extend capacity, ensure quality execution, and deliver against strategic objectives.Bring innovative ideas to advance the external communications team in terms of techniques and new tools.Operate with strong project management discipline, balancing multiple priorities and stakeholders to deliver consistently high-quality results on tight timelines.Identify and implement innovation opportunities, including integrating AI into workflows where appropriate

Successful candidate will possess

Exceptional communication skills and sound judgment, with the proven ability to advise senior leaders and make strategic decisions under pressure.Strong media relations expertise and the ability to build trusted relationships and align diverse stakeholders across a matrixed environment.Sharp project management skills with a track record of delivering high-quality results under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.A commitment to coaching and mentoring junior team members, paired with a growth mindset toward adopting new technologies and AI platforms.

The Team

Deloitte's Marketing, Brand & Communications team combines the power of Deloitte's brand with inspired marketing minds to produce envy-inducing business results. From events to social media to digital assets and execution, our blend of insights from our expert marketers and world-class creative talent produces attention-grabbing campaigns anchored in data-infused strategies. When stakeholders need next-level solutions that support their business priorities, Marketing, Brand & Communications is the partner that can transform big ideas into big impact.

Qualifications

Communications professional with a minimum of 12+ years relevant experience A bachelor's degree, preferably in Communications, English, Public Relations, or JournalismDeep understanding of the TMT landscape, with a strong background in media relations best practices, reporter engagement, connection and use of social media to amplify media coverage.Proven success in developing and executing external communications strategy and communications plans for a large business, preferably in professional servicesExcellent interpersonal, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to interact with and coach senior leaders and highly intellectual thinkersStrong listening and persuasive communication skills; able to gain consensus through influence and ability to pivot when warrantedExperience in measuring the effectiveness of communication strategies Negotiation and critical thinking skills; flexibility and adaptabilityHigh-level proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook and Word. Knowledgeable in all aspects of Microsoft Office and ancillary programsas well as with media relations platforms such as Muck Rack and Meltwater.Understanding of GEO and interconnectivity between media relations and LLMsLimited immigration sponsorship may be availableAbility to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. emergencycommunicationsspecialistdispatc.title: Emergency Communications Specialist/Dispatcher
emergencycommunicationsspecialistdispatc.description:
Emergency Communications Specialist
This position offers a new hire incentive:


$600 paid upon hire ($300 for part-time)$300 paid upon completion of a successful field training program ($150 for part-time)$300 paid upon completion of a successful (passing evaluation) 1-year period ($150 for part-time)New hires who receive this incentive and voluntarily leave City employment on or before completion of six months' employment shall repay the City the full $600 new hire incentive ($300 for part-time).
Job Summary
Receives citizen and other incoming 9-1-1 emergency or non-emergency calls; analyzes nature of call depending on life and death status as circumstances are described by conversation; provides verbal emergency or non-emergency assistance or information and, depending on situation priority, directs or dispatches call information to appropriate City individuals/departments for immediate or follow-up action.


Essential Functions
Answers calls and, as appropriate, provides verbal instructions, assistance and information; directs for action all 9-1-1 lines, and Police and Fire emergency lines according to standard procedures.Quickly assesses type, nature and status of emergency or non-emergency call and dispatches for priority follow-up to Police, Fire, EMS, Animal Control, and other City departments.Answers and relays teletype messages, radio messages, mobile data messages, intercom messages and interoffice messages.Monitors multiple radio frequencies and operates equipment within standard and non-standard emergency and non-emergency situations and conditions.Monitors City and other security alarm systems and, when an emergency occurs, notifies and dispatches the appropriate City assistance.Operates computer systems to enter City and Criminal Investigation Division (CID) warrants; logs in to Texas Crime Information Center (TCIC), National Crime Information Center (NCIC), and regional and Tarrant County computer systems to monitor and maintain up-to-date records on stolen items, vehicles, checks and wanted individuals, etc.Records and maintains department activity records.Performs related duties as directed when such duties are a logical and appropriate assignment to the position.Regular and timely attendance are required for this position.Interacts professionally and respectfully with the public, coworkers and others in the course of daily work.Required Skills:
Skills, knowledge and abilities:


Must be able to use judgement (developed through education, training and experience) and standard operating procedures to segregate calls by their emergency or non-emergency status.Ability to elicit information from callers who are under considerable stress.Good typing skills, particularly with numbers, and prefer familiarity with computer and radio operations and communications equipment.Requires consistent use of analysis, mental judgment, and discretion often at a very rapid pace due to workload demands that can result in a high pressure/high stress work climate.Must have the ability to multi-task.Must demonstrate excellent interpersonal, written communication, leadership, and decision-making/problem solving skills.Ability to work rotating shifts, weekends and holidays.Education, experience and other requirements:High school diploma or equivalent. Requires Basic Telecommunicator License and passing of State licensing test issued by Texas Commission on Law Enforcement (TCOLE) within one year of hire.Due to Criminal Justice Information Security (CJIS) requirements, the candidate must never have been convicted, put on court-ordered community supervision, or probation for any criminal offense above the grade of Class B misdemeanor or a Class B misdemeanor within the last ten years from the date of the court order. Class A Misdemeanor Conviction, Deferred Adjudication or Felony Conviction are permanent disqualifiers.All applicants must pass department required testing, oral interview board, and drug/physical screening.Must pass a Federal/National criminal background investigation and credit check, psychological screening, and polygraph exam.Must have a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record as defined by City policy and the ability to obtain a Texas driver's license in accordance with Texas State law.Must pass a pre-employment physical, drug screen, Titmus vision screening, Ishihara vision screening, and audio (whisper test) screening.Working Conditions:
While performing the essential functions of this position the employee is rarely exposed to disagreeable environmental factors. Works under stress when confronted with emergency, critical, or dangerous situations; performs a variety of tasks, often changing from one task to another of a different nature without loss of efficiency or composure; works without constant supervision; courteously assists citizens and the general public and other employees with situations that are frequently complicated or serious in nature; maintains confidentiality with criminal and investigative information; and must concentrate on assigned tasks through many distractions. Works flexible hours to include all shifts; nights, weekends, and holidays and accept on-call duty status.


Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is regularly required to perform light to medium work that involves walking or standing, use the computer keyboard and mouse, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, talk and hear, stand, walk, and stoop, or crouch. This position requires occasionally lifting and/or moving up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.


This job requires the ability to work in an office environment where the noise level is usually moderate.

chiefmarketingofficercolliersengineering.description:
Overview

At Colliers Engineering & Design (CED), our mission is to advance the built environment to accelerate the success of our communities, clients, and people. Guided by our vision to lead the industry through expertise, innovation, and sustainable solutions, the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) plays a critical role in realizing that ambition.


As a key member of the leadership team, the CMO drives a strategic, insight-driven, and client-focused marketing function that connects business goals, brand strategy, and client engagement across all markets and disciplines. This role ensures that marketing is a core driver of growth, innovation, and alignment across the enterprise.

 

Partnering closely with the CEO and executive leadership, the CMO aligns marketing strategy with firmwide business objectives and market intelligence, building the structure, systems, and talent needed to support CED’s continued expansion. Leading a multidisciplinary organization spanning Public Relations, Communications, Brand and Design, Digital Strategy, Marketing Technology, Market Strategists, and regional marketing teams, the CMO ensures integrated marketing and business development efforts that elevate visibility, engagement, and growth across all divisions.

 

Please note that candidates who are not based in our Holmdel, NJ headquarters will be required to travel to the office as needed.

 
Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Alignment

Develop and execute a firmwide marketing strategy aligned with CED’s mission and vision for leadership through innovation and expertise.Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted partner to the CEO and executive team, ensuring marketing informs business planning, growth, and integration.Design and implement scalable systems, processes, and playbooks to drive consistency and efficiency across divisions.Align marketing priorities and investments with the firm’s highest-value opportunities to achieve measurable ROI.Embed CED’s purpose and values into all marketing activities to reinforce a trusted, unified brand.People, Structure & Development

Build and sustain a high-performing marketing organization with clear roles, accountability, and capabilities aligned to business goals.Lead with integrity and agility, positioning marketing as a trusted, strategic partner in firmwide growth.Develop leadership depth and succession pipelines through mentorship and professional growth opportunities.Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and accountability that empowers marketers to innovate and deliver results.Brand Strategy & Market Positioning

Lead the ongoing evolution of the CED brand to ensure consistency, relevance, and differentiation across markets.Champion a compelling brand narrative highlighting CED’s technical excellence, innovative spirit, and community impact.Ensure the quality and consistency of brand assets, messaging, and storytelling across all channels.Connect CED’s work to its broader purpose through authentic storytelling, thought leadership, and client engagement.Innovation, Insights & Technology

Promote a culture of innovation, encouraging new ideas, tools, and approaches that drive performance.Stay at the forefront of marketing, communications, and client engagement trends to maintain CED’s competitive edge.Champion marketing technologies, automation, and analytics to enhance scalability and data-driven decisions.Leverage research, benchmarking, and client insights to anticipate opportunities and inform strategy.Marketing Performance & Effectiveness

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure marketing effectiveness and impact.Use analytics and insights to optimize strategies, resources, and client engagement outcomes.Drive budget discipline and ROI accountability to ensure marketing investments deliver business value.Promote transparency and continuous improvement across marketing operations.Cross-Functional Collaboration

Act as a strategic connector across the firm, ensuring marketing contributes meaningfully to enterprise strategy and growth.Build strong partnerships with executive, divisional, and functional leaders to align goals and deliver unified strategies.Strengthen collaboration among marketing, business development, and operations to enhance client experience and market reach.Support integration, change, and growth initiatives with clear communication and strategic alignment. 
Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or Business; MBA or advanced degree preferred.15+ years of senior marketing leadership experience in complex, multi-division organizations; experience in growth or transformation environments preferred.Demonstrated experience in the AEC industry, preferably within engineering and/or architecture organizations preferred.Prior experience working in a large, complex firm environment is strongly preferred. “Large” is defined as organizations with 2,500+ employees, multi-office national footprints, and multiple service lines, divisions, or market sectors.Experience supporting or operating within a high-growth organization, including exposure to mergers and acquisitions, integration efforts, or rapid scaling initiatives, is highly desirable and considered a strong differentiator.Proven success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable business growth.Deep understanding of brand strategy, client engagement, and data-driven marketing, ideally within professional services or related industries.Strong business acumen with expertise in financial management, performance metrics, and ROI analysis.Exceptional leadership, communication, and change management skills; able to inspire and align diverse teams.Demonstrated ability to balance strategic vision with disciplined execution across functions and markets.Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions. 

 
What We Offer

At Colliers Engineering & Design, our people are our most important resource. That’s why we are committed to providing all our employees with a safe, comfortable work environment, potential for career advancement, and the ability to impact society through their projects as well as Company sponsored activities.


This dedication begins with supporting a work life balance through a generous compensation package that includes: company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid pregnancy disability leave; short- and long-term disability insurance; life insurance; a company-matched 401(k)/Roth; paid time off that includes parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses and a straight time policy that compensates exempt employees for billable hours worked in excess of 40 billable hours within a work week.


We have also created an internal culture that provides the resources and technology needed to encourage personal and professional growth opportunities through reimbursement for education; a free in-house resource for hundreds of educational and self-enrichment courses; mentorship program; wellness program; Women’s Organization and ongoing philanthropic opportunities.


Apply today to learn how you can join our team of professionals, so we can help you Accelerate Your Success!

Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

Our Marketing Manager Lead, Journeys & Personalization is responsible for ongoing management of agency resources, campaign and channel plans and related budgets that achieve stated objectives. Develops partnerships with various internal and external resources to develop and deliver go-to market plans for USAA brand and products that contribute to goals outlined by strategy/market performance. Ensures the on-time, orderly flow of all projects from initiation to release, through responsible project delivery execution.

USAA is seeking a strategic and data-driven Marketer to lead the strategy, design, and optimization of end-to-end customer journeys across Property & Casualty (P&C) acquisition and engagement programs.

This role will be responsible for architecting journeys for both members and non-members across owned channels and select paid media touchpoints. The ideal candidate will combine customer-centric thinking, marketing strategy, personalization expertise, and data-driven decision-making to reduce friction throughout the funnel, increase customer engagement, and improve conversion performance.

You will partner closely with Marketing, MarTech, Analytics, Product Marketing, Digital Experience, Media, and external partners to deliver connected experiences that drive measurable business outcomes.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site 4 days per week.

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

What You'll Do

Implements strategies and tactics to support the acquisition, development and retention of business and / or effectively manages agency to ensure alignment with goals and priorities over multiple products/strategies.Applies expert knowledge of marketing principles to complex, and often unique work assignments.Applies expert knowledge of the business, its products and processes, advising senior management on issues.Leads and motivates cross functional team members in the development and implementation of key initiatives.Serves as the primary resource for cross-functional team members on escalated issues of a unique nature.Leads the process management role through the creation, monitoring and execution of new processes, in addition to enhancing current processes.Assigns the appropriate level of resources for marketing programs based on key business goals and / or is responsible for leading the development and overall project management oversight of multiple marketing campaigns and go-to market plans.Leads the facilitation and maintenance of data in internal systems and / or campaign planning tools and / or applies mathematical and statistical concepts to effectively gather and interpret data.Directs analyses, root cause identification and development and recommendation of key work product.Creates and uses a product and service strategy to leverage placement (distribution) principles and strategies to maximize business growth and / or makes appropriate recommendations based on evaluation of prospect / customer needs and receptivity.Effectively follows the marketing process to coordinate and align peers, enterprise partners and senior management.Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.8 or more years of relevant business support and / or general analysis experience.Demonstrated leadership experience.Subject-matter-expert knowledge of Microsoft Office Tools to include Word, Excel and Access.Subject-matter-expert knowledge of relevant industry data sources.

What Sets You Apart

Deep experience designing and optimizing customer journeys across acquisition, lead nurture, and conversion programs.Demonstrated success improving conversion rates through personalization, testing, and customer experience optimization.Expertise leveraging customer data, segmentation, CDPs, identity resolution, or audience activation platforms.Experience developing personalization strategies across owned and paid marketing channels.Strong understanding of behavioral marketing, lifecycle marketing, and journey orchestration.Experience creating and executing structured A/B and multivariate testing programs.Ability to translate complex customer insights and data into actionable marketing strategies.Strong executive presence with experience influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale, complex initiatives that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $114,080 - $218,030.

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. digitalmarketingstrategisteicagency.description:
Mission

Take over day-to-day performance strategy, measurement, launch readiness, and delivery prioritization for a defined portfolio of EIC's white-label and platform clients. The goal is to move the founder from routine client-delivery decisions, diagnosis, and QA into exception review while helping Account Managers communicate clearly and Ad Managers execute the approved strategy correctly.

This is a hands-on growth role, not a reporting-only or hands-off consulting position. We want someone with strong fundamentals, technical curiosity, ownership, and the humility to learn EIC's approach. The Manager must be willing to investigate abnormal performance, enter unfamiliar platforms, debug tracking and integrations, and coach the team through implementation. Responsibility and autonomy will expand as judgment and trust are demonstrated.

The PodThe initial 90-day engagement is focused on one assigned pod rather than EIC's entire client roster.

The Manager quarterbacks the pod through strategy, prioritization, coaching, standards, and QA. Formal direct reports are not required initially, although people-management responsibility may develop as the role expands.

Account Manager: Owns client relationships, communication, timelines, and coordination.Ad Manager: Owns campaign builds, trafficking, daily optimization, testing, and routine execution.Performance Strategy & Analytics Manager: Owns business goals, channel and funnel strategy, weekly priorities, measurement, launch readiness, data quality, and final recommendations.Core ResponsibilitiesTranslate business goals into media strategy, including audience, offer, funnel, channel mix, budget, testing plan, and KPIs tied to client economics.Set the pod's weekly priorities by identifying the highest-impact risks and opportunities and turning them into a sequenced work queue for Account Managers and Ad Managers.Detect and diagnose performance problems across campaigns, creative, budgets, search terms, websites, forms, tracking, CRM, integrations, reporting, lead quality, and sales process.Direct recovery through an execution-ready plan with owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria, then stay involved until the root cause is corrected and the result is verified in production.Own launch readiness across strategy, creative, targeting, budget, access, tracking, CRM handoff, reporting, and client approvals. Separate true blockers from work that can safely continue after launch.Own end-to-end measurement and data flow from ad platforms through websites, forms, call tracking, analytics, CRM, automation, qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and ROAS.Work directly inside platforms when complex setup, debugging, QA, recovery, or training requires it. Routine trafficking and daily optimization remain with the Ad Manager whenever practical.Lead client strategy conversations, quarterly recaps, media planning, and responsible forecasting using actual business performance, clear assumptions, and known constraints.Turn founder judgment into repeatable decision rules, QA standards, diagnostic processes, launch criteria, and escalation thresholds.What Success Looks LikeEvery account in the pod has an agreed business goal, funnel, KPI hierarchy, source of truth, and prioritized action plan.Material performance changes are identified early, investigated across the full system, and resolved at the root cause.Launches have verified tracking, CRM handoff, reporting, and optimization signals before avoidable problems reach the client.Account Managers know what to communicate, Ad Managers know what to execute and why, and clients understand the strategy and tradeoffs.Founder involvement moves from routine prioritization, diagnosis, and QA to defined exception review.Each quarter closes with a clear performance story and an evidence-based next-quarter plan and forecast.Required ExperienceApproximately 6–10 years across paid media strategy, account leadership, performance marketing, marketing operations, or related work. Capability and judgment matter more than a rigid year count.Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads, with sound judgment across channels such as LinkedIn, programmatic, geofencing, and retargeting.Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels or server-side events, offline conversions, call tracking, and attribution.Ability to connect websites and forms with CRM, automation, and reporting systems through native integrations, APIs, or webhooks.Ability to audit campaign builds against strategy, diagnose anomalies, and turn findings into an execution-ready repair plan.Comfort with browser developer tools, tag debugging, cookie and network inspection, platform diagnostics, and CRM record tracing. Software engineering experience is not required.Experience translating complex performance into clear client narratives, quarterly plans, and responsible forecasts.Strong business acumen across conversion rates, sales capacity, CAC, LTV, payback, pipeline, revenue, and ROAS.Strong convictions loosely held, disciplined QA, clear communication, coachability, and calm ownership under pressure.How the Role GrowsFirst 30 days: Learn EIC's framework, shadow pod reviews, audit the assigned accounts, and learn the current platforms, commitments, and workflows.Days 31–60: Prepare weekly priorities, own analysis and recommendations for selected accounts, coach an Ad Manager through implementation, and lead part of a client strategy discussion.Days 61–90: Run the pod's weekly performance review, priority queue, launch and measurement QA, planning, and client strategy conversations, with the founder reviewing exceptions rather than building the answer.Long term: Expand account and team ownership as judgment, leverage, and business need are demonstrated.Compensation and StructurePaid 90-day, part-time engagement averaging approximately 15 hours per week.Starting compensation of $4,500–$5,500 per month, based on experience and demonstrated capability.Scope, responsibility, hours, and compensation will be formally reviewed at the end of the engagement.Path to a larger part-time or full-time role for someone who demonstrates the ability to independently own the pod.Hiring Proof PointsCandidates should be prepared to walk through:

A system they designed that connected ad spend to qualified pipeline or revenue.A material performance decline they diagnosed, including how they proved the root cause and validated recovery.A launch they kept on track despite access, tracking, CRM, reporting, or approval blockers.A campaign build that did not match strategy and the exact rebuild direction they provided.A recommendation they changed because CRM or business data contradicted platform data.A difficult client conversation that turned complex information into a clear decision.A time they coached an executor, documented the process, and reduced future escalations.An unfamiliar platform or system they learned quickly and how they verified the solution.

You've Never Been Satisfied with "Good Enough."


You didn't get into this to manage one piece of a project. You got into it to change how the world gets built.


At Accenture Construct, that's the job. You'll help deliver the data centers, power grids, rail networks, factories and public infrastructure that keep communities moving — smarter, safer and more sustainably.


You'll work alongside people who think big and act bold: project managers, engineers, technologists and strategists who pair real-world delivery with AI. And you won't be handed a slice of it. We take on whole programs, from early strategy through construction and handover, and we stand behind how they land.



Because “good enough” builds the past. You're here to build what's next.
 
Visit us here to learn more about ​Accenture Construct

As Accenture continues to grow, you may see a variety of new career opportunities, and depending on the role and location you may be directed to apply through Accenture LLP or one of our other legal entities - Accenture Construct LLC or Accenture Construct Inc., with benefits varying by country and role, so please check with your recruiter for details.


THE WORK:

You'll lead day-to-day stakeholder engagement and communications programs supporting large-scale infrastructure and capital projects.
You'll serve as a trusted advisor to public agency clients, project teams, and contractors, providing strategic communications and stakeholder engagement guidance.
You'll develop and implement outreach strategies that foster understanding, address concerns, and maintain positive relationships with communities, businesses, elected officials, and other key stakeholders.
You'll prepare clear, compelling communications materials and executive-level messaging that translate complex technical information into accessible, audience-focused content.
You'll manage public meetings, community events, stakeholder inquiries, and issue resolution efforts to support project objectives and stakeholder satisfaction.
You'll analyze stakeholder feedback and provide strategic recommendations to clients and project leadership to inform decision-making and project delivery.
You'll confidently present project updates, engagement strategies, and recommendations to executive leadership, elected officials, governing boards, and public audiences.
You'll develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare progress reports to measure program effectiveness and communicate results to clients.
You'll identify stakeholder, reputational, and political risks and support the development of proactive mitigation strategies.
You'll build and maintain relationships with public agencies, contractors, teaming partners, and industry organizations throughout California.
You'll identify and support the pursuit of new business opportunities across transportation, transit, water, energy, and public infrastructure markets.
You'll lead and contribute to proposal development, qualifications packages, interview presentations, and grant applications.
You'll develop persuasive technical narratives, executive summaries, and win themes that strengthen pursuit strategies and proposal submissions.
You'll contribute to capture planning, market research, and account development activities that support business growth objectives.
You'll represent Accenture at industry events, conferences, and client meetings to strengthen market presence, expand relationships, and generate new opportunities.
$120,000 - $135,000 a year
